correctness.rationale: For each X, the two outputs depend exactly on its full E-block set F and the closed-neighborhood image of its active E-block set D. All pairs F⊆D are attainable because every block has ≥2 points. Disjoint neighborhood cases (empty, full, proper one-sided) yield the bivariate polynomial with no double counting. The degree cancellation proof reconstructs max(m,n) and m+n. The included verifier independently exhausts 19 finite families and the inverse polynomial for 120 width pairs; the unrestricted result relies on the combinatorial proof.

value.rationale: The natural object is the E-compatible rough-set lattice for a complete-bipartite quotient, a canonical non-transitive tolerance family. Its distinct-output spectrum determines the quotient up to graph isomorphism, gives the exact lattice size and all lower/upper block-rank multiplicities, and proves a sharp information limit: internal block sizes are invisible. This is an exact classification of a motivated invariant, not an arbitrary numeric slice or a recount of raw input subsets.
